scripts.dev: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && concurrently -k -n tsc,api,worker -c blue,green,magenta "tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "node --env-file-if-exists=../../.env --enable-source-maps --watch dist/main.js" "node --env-file-if-exists=../../.env --enable-source-maps --watch dist/worker.js"
scripts.openapi: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node dist/gerar-openapi.js && prettier --write openapi.json
